Switch

A toggle switch built on role="switch" with aria-checked. The track reads --color-border when off and --color-action when on; the sliding thumb uses --color-surface. Space and Enter toggle the control; the live region below each switch announces the new state. Both themes below render the full state set — on, off, focusable, and disabled.

Light theme

Email notifications On
Weekly digest Off
Auto-sync (locked on) On, disabled
Beta features (locked off) Off, disabled
Icon-only control (uses aria-label)

Dark theme

Email notifications On
Weekly digest Off
Auto-sync (locked on) On, disabled
Beta features (locked off) Off, disabled
Icon-only control (uses aria-label)

Copy-paste snippet

<!-- Switch: role=switch + aria-checked. Label it with aria-labelledby
     (visible text) or aria-label (icon-only controls). -->
<button type="button" class="hisd-switch" role="switch"
        aria-checked="false" aria-label="Email notifications"></button>

<!-- With a visible label and an optional polite live region: -->
<div class="hisd-switch-field hisd-switch-field--spread">
  <span class="hisd-switch-field__label" id="notif-label">Email notifications</span>
  <button type="button" class="hisd-switch" role="switch"
          aria-checked="false" aria-labelledby="notif-label"
          data-live="#notif-live"></button>
  <span id="notif-live" class="visually-hidden" aria-live="polite"></span>
</div>

<!-- Toggle the boolean by flipping aria-checked between "true"/"false".
     Disable with the disabled attribute or aria-disabled="true". -->
